name: shuggle
description: Free unlimited AI chatting on Kaggle GPU hours — uncensored 27B on T4 x2, multi-token rotation, one-file app, branching chats, memory, skills, vision, web search.

scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun build src/shuggle.ts --compile --minify --outfile=shuggle
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit --allowImportingTsExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target esnext --lib esnext,dom --skipLibCheck src/shuggle.ts
